rules.name: Lateral Movement: RDP Followed by Credential Access
rules.description: Detects lateral movement: rdp followed by credential access — lateral movement chain correlation
rules.query: event.category:"network" AND (network.protocol:("smb" OR "rdp" OR "winrm" OR "wmi") AND source.ip:(10.* OR 172.16.* OR 192.168.*) AND destination.ip:(10.* OR 172.16.* OR 192.168.*) AND source.ip != destination.ip)
author: SIEM Alert Rules
